text:
Mia Tran: Quick heads-up — marketing + sales sync: we need to lock down inbound handoff SLAs for Q3. HubSpot rules + SF mapping are still leaking ownership during enrichment windows.
Sam Ortiz: Agreed. Saw ~7% of leads with no owner after enrichment in the last 24h. Root cause looks like enrichment webhook delay + RR pick not firing.
Jordan Lee: Can we get concrete SLA numbers? I suggest: 30s assign on un-enriched leads, 120s assign after enrichment, 95% success target. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Lina Patel: Those feel reasonable. Also want an alert when round-robin skips >3 times for a lead (indicates mapping failures).
Sam Ortiz: +1 on alert. Also we should add a fallback owner rule for VIP leads (utm=partner or company_size>500) to a dedicated queue immediately.
Mia Tran: Good call. For VIPs: 10s assign, bypass enrichment. For everything else follow the 30s/120s tiers.
Alex R: From ops side — HubSpot webhook retries are currently 5 attempts over 2 minutes. We can shorten retries and surface failure to the handoff service earlier.
Jordan Lee: Can you drop the config patch in hs-sf-mapper and tag me? I can do a quick smoke tomorrow morning.
Alex R: Will do. Patch snippet:```yaml
webhook:
  retries: 3
  retry_window_seconds: 45
  failure_hook: handoff-alerts
```
Mia Tran: Nice. For round-robin fixes: we should ensure deterministic hashing by contact_id + created_at so duplicates don't rotate unpredictably.
Sam Ortiz: We saw non-determinism when enrichment rewrites email addresses. Use immutable id only.
Lina Patel: Also add a small claim-back window: if owner doesn't accept within 5m, return to RR with +1 priority for next claim. That reduces stale ownerships.
Mia Tran: Action items: 1) Alex to push webhook retry change (due: tomorrow EOD). 2) Jordan to smoke test RR determinism with immutable id (due: +1 day). 3) Lina to draft fallback VIP queue rule and 4) Ops-bot to add alert: "rr_skip_count>3" and "lead_unassigned>120s".
ops-bot: Alert rule created: rr_skip_count > 3 -> #marketing-oncall, lead_unassigned > 120 -> #sales-escalations (created by ops-bot at 3412345712).
Sam Ortiz: Can we add a short playbook line for SDRs: "If you see unassigned VIP, claim from #vip-fallback and ping @Mia" — helps until automations settle.
Mia Tran: I'll add that to the inbound playbook doc and send a short launch post in #marketing when done.
Jordan Lee: Quick nit — make sure the hs-sf mapping preserves company domains mapping so enrichment doesn't flip leads to 'unknown'.
Alex R: Adding mapping unit test. Will include a sample payload in the PR.
Lina Patel: Timeline check: if all go green, can we ship these changes before the next webinar (2 weeks)?
Mia Tran: Yes — plan is to ship within 7 business days. We'll schedule a short retro after rollout to check metrics: unassigned_rate, time_to_assign_p95, rr_skip_rate.
Sam Ortiz: I'll create a dashboard card for those metrics.
Mia Tran: Perfect. Thanks team :rocket: 
Alex R: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/hs-sf-mapper/pulls/234 — tag @Jordan @Mia for review.
Jordan Lee: Reviewing now, will approve once unit tests pass.
Lina Patel: Thanks all. I'll draft the VIP fallback rule and sample SDR playbook blurb today.
Mia Tran: Closing the thread — will post the playbook update and launch notice once PR merged.
